_about: English data for the panel: texts that the server hands over (not strings of the interface itself). Key absent — the Russian original is shown.

commands.kit:doctor: Project readiness: config, skills, secrets in git, engine version, folder structure, file-name portability. `--structure` — details per folder outside the schema.
commands.kit:hooks: Git hooks: pre-commit with the linter and the ratchet (errors may not grow); in the kit also commit-msg, so internal names do not reach history.
commands.kit:remap-sources: Retarget cards' `source:` after a mirror moved (Confluence — by page_id, Jira — by issue key).
commands.kit:update: Update the engine in a project to the kit's version (preview, then `--apply`); `--structure-only` — only the schema folders.
commands.kit:i18n: Panel interface languages: completeness of every catalogue against the markup; `--new <code> <name>` creates a language.
commands.kit:skills: Put Aurora's skills into the agent's shared folder (`~/.claude/skills`) so `/aurora-vault` and `/aurora-dev` are found in any conversation.
commands.kit:mcp: The base as a tool for any assistant: server check and a ready connection line. The server only reads — writing through MCP is impossible.
commands.kit:list: This reference: commands, modifiers, what executes them, since which version.
commands.sync:sources: Source modules: what is installed and which mirrors are connected to the project.
commands.sync:confluence: Deterministic mirror Confluence → `Sources/Confluence/` (module `confluence-dc`); re-downloads only pages whose version changed.
commands.sync:web: Pages by a list of URLs → `Sources/Web/` (module `web`); trust is a tick per link, written into the saved file's header.
commands.sync:audit: Mirror integrity: missing / orphan / collision / stale state / foreign files, including schemas of pages that no longer exist; walks every connected module.
commands.sync:diff: Drift: a source changed after the knowledge was built.
commands.sync:jira-status: The reverse flow: issue statuses → candidates for `req_status`, issues without requirements, links by mention.
commands.kb:build: Card extraction: plan, batches and ledger by script, the extraction itself by the model; `--slice`, `--card`, `--append`, `--reopen`, `--thin`.
commands.kb:ingest-office: docx/pdf/xlsx/pptx from `Raw/` → Markdown transcripts next to the original; scans are read by a vision model if configured.
commands.kb:ingest: A document from `Raw/` → cards linked to the primary source; the branch is chosen by the document: a spec → REQ with `tz_ref`, a meeting transcript → summary, DR, REQ and facts.
commands.kb:repair: Repair: broken links, homoglyphs, legacy frontmatter, fields outside the schema, stubs for links; modes by flag (`--titles`, `--terms`, `--gone-sources`, `--template`, `--copies`, `--aliases`, `--sections`, …). Preview without `--apply`.
commands.kb:names: File and folder names by the strictest rules of Windows, macOS and Linux: long Confluence paths, card names with links, case-only differences.
commands.kb:translit: The Latin↔Cyrillic name dictionary: finds cards with a transliterated name and Russian content, keeps one translation per concept in `meta/translit.md`, renames by it (`--rename`).
commands.kb:dedupe: Duplicates: search and batch merge by rule (`--merge-all`), including one name in different spellings.
commands.kb:twins: Cards carrying the same knowledge under different names: compares texts, not names. Merges nothing — names the group.
commands.kb:split: Cut a bloated card by its headings: the parts become atomic cards, the card becomes a document map linking to them.
commands.kb:embed: The base's semantic index: card vectors for search by meaning; the index lies outside git and is rebuilt; texts go to the same gateway as the agent.
commands.kb:moc: Maps of content by groupings (terms, concepts, roles, data…), per source document (`--by-source`), per artifact code (`--by-code`) and a list of abandoned cards.
commands.kb:index: Regenerate sections' `_index.md`; hand-written ones are not touched but stale ones are named as a finding (exit code 1).
commands.kb:scrub: Personal data: find and cover with markers; the mode is `privacy.scrub`.
commands.kb:schema: The card schema version (`schema_version`) and migration of the base between versions along a declared chain.
commands.kb:correct: Corrective artifacts: a human writes in their own words what is wrong in a card and how it really is. Lives in `Raw/corrections/` and is applied at EVERY build; `--check`, `--retire`.
commands.kb:supersede: Replace knowledge with history: deprecated → `_archive`, links rewritten. A requirement is not replaced without `--changed` and `--migration`.
commands.kb:links: The link graph: Requirement Yogi keys and story numbers; `--cards` carries links into cards' `related:`; `--cards-json` exports the base's own graph for the panel.
commands.kb:map: What the graph says: communities that have grown to their own map, bridges between topics and islands unreachable by links.
commands.kb:graph-export: The base's graph outward: `meta/graphify/graph.json` in graphify format with link type and confidence, themes by modularity, notes in `MOC/Сообщества/`, an offline graph page.
commands.kb:code-graph: The project's code and SQL in the graph without a model: tables from SQL on pages and in `*.sql`, table pairs of one query, cards naming a table; code from `graphify: code_dirs`.
commands.kb:reset: Wipe the base and rebuild: removes what will be rebuilt (a card with a live `source:` or `built: machine`), touches nothing outside `AuroraKnowledgeDB/`; cards of unknown origin stay (`--list-unknown`, `--drop-unknown`); rollback from git.
commands.kb:lint: Mechanical errors of the base: links, frontmatter, card kinds, artifacts in knowledge, secrets, cards without links.
commands.kb:question: Open a question to the customer (Q-NNN): to whom, what it blocks, the deadline.
commands.kb:answer: Record an answer: close the question and carry the knowledge into a REQ / spec / DR.
commands.kb:decide: Draw up a Decision Record (+ supersede an old DR).
commands.kb:garden: Weekly hygiene: a checklist of four scripts, sorting out by a human.
commands.ctx:context: A context pack: selection, status filter, trust headers, a record in `usage.log`; `--mode generate|review|ask|evaluate`, `--budget`, `--save`.
commands.ctx:ask: An answer from the base with quotes; "why not X" — including rejected DRs.
commands.ctx:eval: A regression run of golden questions after syncs and migrations.
commands.ctx:retro: Lessons learned: what the base did not know when we were wrong.
commands.make:kinds: The project's artifact registry: template, result folder, project prompt, the "no technologies" rule per kind and the final-text boundary.
commands.make:create: An artifact in `Artifacts/<type>/` — only a standard type from conventions.md. The manual path; the main one is `agent:make`.
commands.make:review: Check an artifact's quality against the base.
commands.make:review-auto: Review of a story or algorithm without a human: a closed checklist from `review_v2.0.md`, three model runs vote on each question, a script computes the score and verdict; `--page`, `--cql`, `--as-of`.
commands.make:spec: A feature specification from REQ and `knowledge` cards (SDD).
commands.make:spec-pack: A spec bundle: grounds, DRs, abbreviations, DoR risks — one self-contained file.
commands.make:validate: Compare a contractor's implementation and tests with the spec's scenarios.
commands.make:assemble: Assemble a deliverable (OPZ/PMI/user guide) from the base by a template.
commands.ship:publish: An artifact → a generated Confluence page; knowledge cards do not go out. The body is cut at the marker line: "Clarifications", "Assumptions", "In question" stay in the analyst's draft.
commands.ship:export: A deliverable → docx/pdf (pandoc, a corporate template).
commands.ship:release: Freeze the delivered version: a snapshot, a base commit, a date.
commands.ship:acceptance: Acceptance results and sorting out the customer's remarks.
commands.ops:stats: The base's health dashboard: statuses, risks, metrics; `--append-metrics`.
commands.ops:retrieval: Which cards come first for analysts' real queries and what changed since last time: a ranking watchdog.
commands.ops:search-quality: Search quality as a number: self-search — a card's thesis as a question, the right answer known by construction. R@1/R@5/MRR.
commands.ops:gaps: Meaning gaps: a concept named but with no card, a link named but not placed, lonely cards, a thesis behind its source, a vanished source.
commands.ops:todo: What is left: what routes and commands will finish, what repair did not take, what depends on project settings and where a human decides.
commands.ops:impact: What depends on a card; `--explain` — what a document is built on.
commands.ops:trace: Tracing: spec item → REQ → SPEC → Jira → AC → PMI → acceptance.
commands.ops:trace-table: The "artifact ↔ issue" table: direct links, links by code and tracing by names two hops deep; trust is computed on it.
commands.kb:trust: Recompute cards' trust class: a Confluence section with the "trust" tick, a reference branch, then links — the weakest decides (result: status knowledge/draft and the basis in words; a human assigns no trust).
commands.kb:kind: A card's kind: dictionary, document or knowledge — it decides whether a model may rewrite the body (result: the `kind` field).
commands.ops:questions: The question registry: open, overdue, what they block.
commands.ops:report: The analyst-efficiency dashboard: weekly activity in Jira and Confluence, issue transitions; settings — in the `reports:` section of the config.
commands.agent:aliases: The agent resolves synonym conflicts: clarifies where cards differ and defers real duplicates to a human; edits only through engine commands.
commands.agent:build: The agent parses a batch of sources into cards (result: new cards, trust is not assigned): storyboard, topic boundaries, names, the parse mark; `--until-done`, `--critic`.
commands.agent:distill: Write theses for `knowledge` cards: the model reads the carried-over text and writes a definition, the verbatim source goes under it; Momus checks each; `--recheck`.
commands.agent:extract: Move others' definitions out of cards: knowledge about another entity moves to its own card and a link takes its place; the move is verbatim.
commands.agent:twins: Decide the fate of cards with matching text: one entity or different is decided by the model from the text. A merge is reversible.
commands.agent:tasks: Return to a subject the knowledge of Jira issues that settled as separate cards: an issue is work, not an entity; its code and link are appended to the subject's card.
commands.agent:clashes: Contradictions between cards about one subject: both sides are quoted verbatim, who is right is decided by a human.
commands.agent:relink: Place links inside finished theses without rewriting the text: the model inserts only markup, the engine strips it and checks the original character by character.
commands.agent:translit: Fill the Latin↔Cyrillic name dictionary for cards named by transliteration: a translation is work with meaning, done by the model.
commands.agent:make: Produce an artifact of a registry type: enrichment from the base, a plan with questions to the analyst, worker, critic, Momus. The stages are marked in the header — after an interruption it resumes from the same point. Understands `@path`, `/skill`, `@server`.
commands.agent:ask: Ask the base in your own words: the engine assembles context, the model answers only from the cards and puts a link on each claim; Momus checks the answer; the conversation goes to `meta/ask/`.
commands.agent:width: Measure how many simultaneous requests each gateway holds: raise the load while throughput grows.
commands.agent:pydantic: Pydantic AI settings: what goes to the gateway per role — model, reasoning on or off, chat-template fields and the timeout, whether the installed version passed the compatibility check.
commands.agent:ping: Check the model chain by a live request: every backend, roles, speed; an empty answer counts as a refusal.
commands.agent:probe: A live connectivity check: asks every gateway now; tells "no connection", "wrong key" and "no such model" apart and shows the model list; `--why` checks the request layer by layer.
commands.dev:qa-list: Engine QA: which cases and scenarios exist, what is covered by an automatic test, which cases were never run.
commands.dev:qa-retrieval: Output on the kit's reference corpus: a ranking watchdog in git. It fails itself when the card order changed — and shows how.
commands.dev:qa-check: Integrity of the QA registry: duplicate numbers, links to non-existent cases, stale versions.
commands.dev:qa-gap: What changed in code and what covers it; the decision "automatic test or case" is taken by the model.
commands.dev:qa-cover: Cover what was done: a coverage table and a ready task for the assistant to add tests, cases and scenarios.
commands.dev:qa-run: Run a scenario with a journal: automatic tests, a step checklist, a report in `Development/QA/runs/`.
commands.dev:qa-new: Create a test case or scenario from a template with the next free number.

scenarios.взять новое из источников и довести до з: take what is new from the sources and bring it to knowledge: sync, parsing in batches, theses, links, trust. The route runs as long as there is work — even twelve hours — and commits every turn to git: switch it off whenever you like, what is done stays and nothing has to be redone. Result: the base knows everything that appeared in the sources

scenarios.Забрать страницы сайтов по списку адресо: Fetch website pages from a list of URLs

scenarios.Карточки, собранные по шаблону страницы,: Cards assembled from a page template, not from knowledge: they go to the archive, their sources back to the plan, where parsing lays the knowledge out among its own entities

scenarios.Связать новые карточки с базой: Link the new cards to the base
scenarios.Карта на каждый разобранный документ: от: A map for every parsed document: where the card came from

scenarios.Починить ссылки, которые появились по хо: Fix the links that appeared during parsing

scenarios.Свести карточки об одном: решает модель,: Merge cards about the same thing: the model decides, the human is not asked

scenarios.Связать всю базу: карты считают брошенны: Link the whole base: maps count the abandoned by incoming links, and making them before the links would be lying

scenarios.Граф базы наружу: связи с типом и уверен: The base's graph outward: links with type and confidence, themes and Obsidian graph colours by trust — for agents through MCP and graphify exports
scenarios.Пересобрать оглавления разделов: Rebuild the section tables of contents
scenarios.Обновить семантический индекс для поиска: Refresh the semantic index for search by meaning
scenarios.Итог: состав базы, доверие, динамика: Result: the make-up of the base, trust, dynamics

scenarios.Завести заготовки под понятия, которые б: Create stubs for concepts the base names in words and knows their expansion
scenarios.Завести карточки под источники вне разбо: Create cards for sources outside parsing: whole templates and pointers to external artifacts
scenarios.Завести карточки тем по папкам источнико: Create theme cards by source folders: an isolated card needs an entrance, and the grouping was set by a human

scenarios.Карта на каждый разобранный документ: A map for every parsed document
scenarios.Карты содержания: до каждой карточки дол: Maps of content: every card must be reachable
scenarios.Проверить схему карточек и мигрировать о: Check the card schema and migrate the lagging ones
scenarios.Что разобрано слишком тонко и стоит пере: What was parsed too thinly and is worth rereading

contrast.name: Contrast
contrast.about: Maximum legibility: pure black background, thick borders, type a step larger, colour only where it carries meaning. For projectors and low vision.

pribory.name: Gauges
pribory.about: A quiet bridge: midnight background, hairlines instead of frames, colour only on status. The glow is left to the one live process. The densest.

redakciya.name: Editorial
redakciya.about: A magazine spread: warm paper, serifs in headings and numbers, air and rules instead of boxes. For long reading of the help and report review.

unicorn.name: Unicorn
unicorn.about: Candy and round corners, hearts instead of diamonds in statuses. The density and the trust scale are the same, AA contrast holds — the skin changes the look, not the meaning.

zine.name: Zine 2.0
zine.about: Dotted paper, ink frames and hard shadows without blur, headings in gold capitals. The default look. Requirements — docs/skin-zine-requirements.md.

messages.карточка выведена из источников: правитс: the card is derived from sources: it is corrected with a corrective artifact, not here — otherwise the next build erases the edit
messages.тип document: тело переносится дословно: kind document: the body is carried over verbatim and nobody rewrites it

confluence-dc.title: Confluence (Server / Data Center / Cloud)
confluence-dc.what: The page tree of a Confluence space: hierarchy as folders, a page with children becomes a folder and index.md. Reads through REST, installs nothing on the server.

jira-dc.title: Jira (Server / Data Center)
jira-dc.what: Issues by JQL: a file per issue, the name is the key. The state accumulates between runs, so a narrow query does not drop the rest from the mirror.

web.title: Web pages
web.what: Pages from a list of URLs: each is saved into the project cache as its own file. For every link a human says whether to trust it — a law and a standard are trusted, a stranger's blog is not.
